answer_1.quote: We verify the effectiveness of our method on text generation and classification, respectively, where we use Persona-Chat and ARSC datasets.

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation has three aspects, • Quality: BLEU-n , and ROUGE  measures the n-gram matching ... PPL (perplexity) measures the sentence fluency. • Diversity. Dist-n evaluates the response diversity ... • Consistency: C score measures the consistency between the generated responses and persona descriptions.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation consists of Quality and Consistency. ... We hire five annotators to score 750 generated sentences in total (250 sentences for each model we evaluate).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to rate each generated response on quality and consistency with the persona.
